summary: Operator site + its Wix Hotels booking widget: 12 full-hookup 20/30/50A RV sites at $35/night bookable online (weekly/monthly also sold); fees, hookups, count confirmed, booking platform/url added. Google 5.0/65, RV Life 5*/$$. Season year_round (derived) left: no page states it. The pond measures ~3.2 acres and the RV loop is ~120 m away - lakeview downgrade lead.
flags: WATERFRONT DOWNGRADE LEAD (lakeview -> not waterfront): the only water body is the operator's own pond ('we completed our pond ... "Play Pond"'), which measures ~3.1-3.3 acres on Esri imagery - under the ~5-acre pond line, and the operator itself calls it a pond, so there is no pond-view value. The RV loop sits ~110-130 m west of its shore across open grass. The About page also claims a '5 acre "mini" lake' added in 2021; imagery shows only this one sizeable water body, so if that is it, it is under 5 acres as seen; even read as a lake the 120 m set-back would be lakeview at best, not on-water.

PRIVATE GATE FACTS: posted rate $35/night (home page + online booking widget, read 2026-11-05) - under US$50; presence = working website + phone 620-875-4244 and a booking engine; Google Maps 5.0 from 65 reviews; RV Life 5* (1 review), $$ (avg $30). Passes.

LONG-STAY (not a drop, reported): the home page leads with 'Offering Weekly & Monthly RV Rates ... $500 Monthly' and one Google reviewer 'stayed here for close to a year', but the park posts a nightly rate and sells single RV nights in its booking widget (test 2 passes), imagery shows 4-5 rigs on 12 sites, and the operator leads with the retreat, cabins, events and restaurant. I do not read it as mostly seasonal.
